triggers: a kernel on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120) risks the '4. Reusing stale scale-factor layout conversion' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120): 4. Reusing stale scale-factor layout conversion

problem.statement: NVFP4 Split-K GEMV Pitfalls -- 4. Reusing stale scale-factor layout conversion

payload.attempted: Keep the old CUTLASS-to-ATREX scale conversion when swapping binaries.
payload.lesson: Every binary change needs a layout sanity test and md5 record.

established_fact.mechanism: FP4 scale-factor layout is part of the ABI. It can change independently from A/B packed data layout.

payload.observed: The accepted `gemm_v3_splitk.so` md5 `bc710eae90003480df15a01d81a09856` consumes CUTLASS-swizzled `SF_B` directly. Old conversion logic is invalid for this binary.
payload.root_cause: FP4 scale-factor layout is part of the ABI. It can change independently from A/B packed data layout.
